propositions: The raw compute_mutations API must preserve its contract to emit field_drift when local_state differs from jira_state, as a positive control for callers.

The production snapshot call-site passes two remote Jira states (prev_snapshot and curr_snapshot) that do not honor the raw API contract and must filter field_drift and unbound_local emissions at that boundary.
A4-1 introduced call-site suppression that allows the raw differ positive control to remain intact while preventing spurious remote-only drift from reaching output.
Modifying _compute_mutations_emit_both would break the load-bearing raw-differ positive control and contradict the intentional A4-1 design decision.

Verification confirms the call-site filter correctly suppresses field-drift for key-set entries while preserving genuine inbound-create and seed mutations and maintaining zero mutation_count in converged states.
